rules.validation: Include only currently operating stores; omit closed or paused locations.
rules.inventory: Describe stable product categories and useful examples; never promise that a specific SKU is in stock today.
rules.mapLink: Prefer the store's canonical Google Maps place URL; coordinates or address search are acceptable fallbacks when no reliable place URL is available.

properties.title: Где искать привычные продукты в Белграде

coordinateSources.note: Coordinates and Google Maps place IDs for selected stores come from the committed «Маленькая РФ» snapshot.
Current addresses, selected coordinates and product categories were checked against official store finders, Wolt and current public map/directory sources.

Follow-up verification of operating status, addresses and Mix Markt geometry. Tadije Sondermajera uses address-complex geometry cross-checked against RGZ-derived address data; the canonical Google Place ID is retained for exact navigation.

Added Prva ruska kuhinja, RusMarket and four current Fix Price locations. Where an exact storefront coordinate was unavailable, the pin intentionally uses address-level or immediately adjacent geometry and should be refined later rather than omitting the operating location.
Multi Cook opening verified by an on-site contributor report and photographs; exact coordinates were supplied from the location.
